# Test-FinalAcceptance.ps1

The confirmed-reconciliation contract also requires validated pre/post NTFS journal boundaries, scan completion time, and consistent captured/overlap/accepted live-event counters; these fields are not optional evidence decorations.

This is the final fail-closed evidence aggregator for the nine groups in `Requirements/21_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_ORCHESTRATION.md`: TestLab/real I/O, confirmed reconciliation, Windows privileged capabilities, Windows 10 22H2, idle resource acceptance, MFT performance, physical installer, live Agent/Explorer correlation, and branch integration. Live Agent/Explorer evidence must reference existing executable/oracle/Explorer files and an Agent history directory.

Each group must be supplied as a real JSON artifact with its required schema, required product-specific fields, `AcceptanceEligible=true`, and a non-diagnostic, non-partial, non-failed status. The TestLab group additionally requires `Status=COMPLETED_REAL_IO_ACCEPTANCE`, `ExecutionMode=TestLab`, and `Diagnostic=false`; each real-I/O stage must contain positive oracle/source/canonical/final-state counts, all-PASS checks, an empty failure list, and an existing history directory. The production Agent is launched with the dedicated `--testlab` host mode rather than the development `--diagnostic` mode. Release-only evidence is required for the privileged, MFT, and formal resource gates. The validator checks the fixed sixteen-capability Windows 11 x64/elevated contract from `build/quality/AcceptanceContracts.ps1`, required capability/test rows and artifact files, the populated privileged oracle/source/canonical/state/reconciliation/service payloads and empty error artifact, the exact eleven installer case IDs and statuses, a passed Windows 11 Hyper-V installer prerequisite before the Windows 11 physical installer result, connected MFT correctness/count/drop evidence plus all required portable/MFT suites, empty MFT failure reasons, and dedicated-volume markers, the fixed 600-second resource and independent quiet-witness checks on a Windows 11 x64 physical machine, live correlation evidence with `FalseExactCount=0`, complete durable source/canonical/final-state counts, matching oracle paths, empty failure list, strict process `FalseExactCount`, and branch state fields. Windows 10 additionally requires the `Compose-Windows10StageA.ps1`-produced Stage A artifact, `SC-Test-W10`/Hyper-V/VM identity, exactly one of each required Stage A check, `Origin=real`, existing check evidence paths, an all-PASS physical Windows 10 22H2 x64 preflight, and a real physical installer manifest. Confirmed reconciliation evidence must also contain matching MFT/lightweight entry counts, candidate/query counters, a mathematically consistent query/candidate ratio, privilege and ACL fallback telemetry, low-priority/I/O-hint telemetry, and non-negative counters and elapsed time. Branch integration additionally requires `main`, both remote branches, a clean worktree, the accepted SHA, HEAD equal to `origin/main`, and `origin/main` containing `origin/devenv`. Missing, malformed, `NOT_EXECUTED`, `AcceptanceEligible=false`, or diagnostic artifacts produce `AcceptanceEligible=false` and exit code 2. Windows privileged product payloads must also reference existing oracle/history/evidence paths; the final gate performs no VM, disk, installer, branch, or network operation and cannot turn a fixture or diagnostic result into acceptance.
